svg.title: Picking quality vs. reported cost
svg.desc: Higher is better. Each model has three threshold settings at the same measured latency or cost. Circle is 0.30, diamond is 0.40, and filled square is 0.50. Positive costs use a log scale; reported zeros have a separate lane. The benchmark page contains the exact values.
svg.text: Higher is better. Each model has three threshold settings at the same measured latency or cost.
Reported USD per 10 tasks (log scale for positive costs)
Zero-cost markers are spaced within their own lane; spacing does not imply a cost difference.
